intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene (600465) on chromosome 10q21.2.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: A homozygous ANK3 mutation in a consanguineous family with intellectual disability supports recessive ID caused by ANK3. The MRT37 label is standard nomenclature.

checks.claim: The ANK3 gene is located on chromosome 10q21.2.
checks.evidence_quote: AnkyrinG, encoded by the ANK3 gene, is involved in neuronal development and signaling.
checks.explanation: The chromosomal location is standard nomenclature. The abstract does not state it.

paragraphs.text: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is characterized by moderate intellectual disability, an attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)-like phenotype, and behavioral problems (Iqbal et al., 2013).

checks.explanation: A homozygous mutation in a consanguineous family is consistent with autosomal recessive inheritance.

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability and an ADHD-like phenotype, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene. The authors stated that this represented the first reported familial mutation in ANK3.

paragraphs.text: Iqbal et al. (2013) found memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog. The authors stated that this supported the causality of the ANK3 mutations in the 2 families they studied and a role for the gene in cognitive function.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) found memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog.
checks.evidence_quote: The causality of ANK3 mutations in the two families and the role of the gene in cognitive function were supported by memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.
checks.explanation: States memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) stated that the Drosophila ANK3-ortholog knockdown findings supported the causality of the ANK3 mutations in the 2 families they studied.
checks.evidence_quote: The causality of ANK3 mutations in the two families and the role of the gene in cognitive function were supported by memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.
checks.explanation: States that the model supported causality in the two families.

checks.explanation: States that the model supported a role in cognitive function.

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability, an ADHD-like phenotype, and behavioral problems (MRT37), Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene. In support of pathogenicity, a Drosophila knockdown model of the ANK3 ortholog showed memory defects.

checks.evidence_quote: The causality of ANK3 mutations in the two families and the role of the gene in cognitive function were supported by memory defects in a Drosophila knockdown model.
